import pyautogui
import pywinctl as pwc
from pathlib import Path
import traceback

# Find OSBC window
windows = [w for w in pwc.getAllWindows\(\) if ''OS Bot'' in w.title]
if not windows:
    print\(''OSBC not found''\)
    exit\(\)

w = windows[0]
print\(f''OSBC window: {w.title}''\)
print\(f''Region: \({w.left}, {w.top}, {w.width}, {w.height}\)''\)

# Try template matching
template_path = Path\(''src/model/actions/templates/launch_button.png''\)
print\(f''Template exists: {template_path.exists\(\)}''\)

if template_path.exists\(\):
    try:
        location = pyautogui.locateOnScreen\(
            str\(template_path\),
            region=\(w.left, w.top, w.width, w.height\),
            confidence=0.8,
        \)
        if location:
            center = pyautogui.center\(location\)
            print\(f''Template found at: \({center.x}, {center.y}\)''\)
        else:
            print\(''Template not found in window \(returned None\)''\)
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f''Template matching error: {type\(e\).__name__}: {e}''\)
        traceback.print_exc\(\)
")
